evidence.summary: OFAC lists it as the Russian Federal Nuclear Center – Zababakhin All-Russia Research Institute of Technical Physics (VNIITF), in Snezhinsk, Chelyabinsk Region, also known as Chelyabinsk-70 and the Kasli Nuclear Weapons Development Center.
It is a Russian federal state unitary enterprise, as its full name on OFAC’s list says.
